commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Armando Broja (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
90+3' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+1' 8 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) comes onto the pitch so that Josh Laurent can be given a rest.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Armando Broja (Burnley) for Zian Flemming.
87' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Rayan will be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
85' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
80' A substitution has been made. Eli Junior Kroupi goes off and David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes on.
79' PENALTY APPEAL by Bournemouth, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
77' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joe Worrall is coming onto the pitch as Maxime Esteve (Burnley) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Lucas Pires (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Quilindschy Hartman.
74' Bournemouth win a corner.

72' Evanilson (Bournemouth) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Martin Dubravka, who tips the ball around the post.
71' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
69' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Here's the change. Lyle Foster leaves the pitch and Marcus Edwards (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
66' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
61' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Adam Smith is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth).
61' Substitution. Ryan Christie will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
60' The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' A decent cross gives Zian Flemming (Burnley) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
57' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

54' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
54' The ball is cleared after Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
49' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

48' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
47' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Peter Bankes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

42' OFF THE BAR! Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) finds some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a shot that only crashes against the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
42' The ball goes out of play and Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Zian Flemming (Burnley) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Peter Bankes no option but to blow his whistle.
39' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.

37' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
37' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) and Kyle Walker combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
31' Kyle Walker (Burnley) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

28' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
28' Burnley earn a corner.
28' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) will deliver the corner kick.
25' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

24' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Djordje Petrovic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner.
23' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

21' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
21' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Zian Flemming (Burnley) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
12' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
7' The corner kick from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Burnley.
5' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
4' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
